title: An IBM Master Inventor on my stretch assignments
summary: An IBM Master Inventor wrote that I drove the org-level hackday with universities in South India, a popular program across IBM's labs.
what_i_did: Took on stretch assignments beyond core delivery, including the university hackday.

quotes.text: He has been responsible for driving the org level Hackday event with Universities in South, which is also a very popular program within IBM Software Labs in India.
His approach to work was very structured and many a times he went out of the way to take on team level tasks.
